'''Reflections Sealed''' is a sealed league format on [[GEMP]] built from [[Reflections]] and [[Reflections II]] boosters. Its format definition uses the same set list as [[Open]].<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /><ref name="lib" /> GEMP's sealed league type ''Reflections Sealed'' uses this format.<ref name="sealedtype" />

* '''Type:''' sealed deck (GEMP sealed league)
* '''Defined by:''' play.swccg.com format; league type from the Players Committee GEMP
* '''Card pool:''' Reflections and Reflections II boosters plus random locations, 40-card decks
* '''In use:''' unknown
* '''GEMP:''' ''Reflections Sealed'' (<code>reflections_sealed</code>) on play.swccg.com; on the Players Committee GEMP the league type ''Reflections Sealed'' is played under the generic [[Sealed]] format<ref name="pc-slt" />

== Card pool ==
Players build decks from the product their sealed league gives them. A league has two series; a player who joins gets the product of every series that has started, and every player gets each later series' product when it starts.<ref name="nsld" /><ref name="slp" />

On play.swccg.com the league issues:<ref name="slp" />
* '''Series 1:''' 8 Reflections Booster Packs and 8 Reflections II Booster Packs, 2 fixed cards (Dark Side ''Twi'lek Advisor'', Light Side ''The Signal''), and one random card from each of four location pools: Dark Side sites (10), Dark Side systems (12), Light Side sites (13) and Light Side systems (13).<ref name="slp" /><ref name="cardjson" />
* '''Series 2:''' 2 Reflections Booster Packs and 2 Reflections II Booster Packs.<ref name="slp" />
A Reflections Booster Pack holds 17 cards from earlier sets plus 1 foil; a Reflections II Booster Pack holds 15 cards from earlier sets, a foil, a combo card and an Expanded Universe card.<ref name="k-ReflectionsBoosterPack" /><ref name="k-ReflectionsIIBoosterPack" /> The Players Committee code's location pools also include 13 Episode I locations, which play.swccg.com leaves out.<ref name="slp" /><ref name="pc-slp" /> The location lists are at [[GEMP sealed league products#Reflections Sealed|GEMP sealed league products]].

The format definition uses the same set list as Open, so the product limits the pool. It sets a deck size of 40 cards and marks the format as not a game hall format, so it is played through its league rather than at open tables.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /><ref name="lib" />

=== Special rule ===
The GEMP format definitions list this special rule:<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="hall" />
* Once per game, a player may ▼ a unique battleground not already on table.

== History ==
The league type comes from the Players Committee GEMP code, which plays it under the generic [[Sealed]] format; play.swccg.com gave it its own format with the same name.<ref name="pc-slt" /><ref name="slt" /><ref name="gemp" />

Decipher's DecipherCon 2000 schedule had several ''Reflections Sealed Booster Draft'' events.<ref name="dcon2000" /> The Players Committee's ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' lists a paper ''Reflections Booster Draft'' with four Reflections, Reflections II or Reflections III boosters, in which each player may bring six battleground locations for the deck.<ref name="afg" /> No source links the GEMP league to these events, and no league result in this format is recorded.
